explanation:
Thermo-nuclear structural review: PASS with no confirmed production defect or structural merge blocker in baseline d2cf18438debba60d87ce46ba6da68bca6f072b3 plus implementation-review.diff SHA256 8e5beba17e58c94b7db47611c9192227ea580a6480b46011be5cce6420c2fc4c; design quality 8.5/10, scoped code-quality readiness 8.5/10—not a verdict on the separately pending traffic/lab evidence—and this review used source and existing logs only, without edits or execution.

Concrete minimal recommendations, ranked: (1) delete the newly added verifier_candidate block at crates/honk-core/src/ebpf/real/routing/tests.rs:855–874 rather than preserve its misleading rollback assertions: load_extension at crates/honk-core/src/ebpf/real/routing.rs:167–216 loads BTF/program FDs but neither attaches a link nor mutates the backend/root, so those unchanged-hit/miss/slot checks cannot exercise the publisher’s load-failure cleanup at routing.rs:327–330; retain the real publisher map-fill failure at tests.rs:818–847 and the existing attachment/root-failure tests, and introduce no injectable-loader framework merely to justify this deleted test stage; (2) make emit_fact_bit at crates/honk-core/src/control/routing_matcher/codegen.rs:628–653 select caches[kind as usize] internally, passing the cache array from its three callers at codegen.rs:463–493, which removes the redundant obligation to pass both a category and its separately selected matching cache without adding another type, wrapper, or dispatch layer; (3) if reducing test scaffolding, reuse the new outbound_ids helper at tests.rs:45–51 in the four existing identical ID-map constructions at tests.rs:531,587,646,744 before inventing a new fixture abstraction.

Hostile second-pass conclusions: DEFEND the private FactKind/FactCache boundary and the separate lookup-versus-bit-test functions—every emitted category reaches the proper lookup branch at codegen.rs:655–692, FD selection already has one authoritative location there, and moving FDs into KernelPredicate or adding a generic fact descriptor merely to co-locate classification would spread backend details into the canonical compiler model at crates/honk-core/src/control/routing_matcher.rs:28–44; DEFEND the separate aligned pointer/ready DW slots at codegen.rs:75–92,298–301,637–653 because uncomputed, computed-NULL and computed-pointer are distinct states, the slot ranges are disjoint from both key buffers, and linux612-packed-ready-rejection.log:613–614 documents the rejected packed-W design hitting 1,000,001 processed instructions while linux612-routing.log:2–12 records the current design passing 7/7; REFINE the large-test-file concern rather than force a split—codegen.rs is 847 lines and tests.rs is 976, so neither crosses 1,000, the added rule data exercises distinct short-circuit/reuse, invocation/generation, IPv6-prefix and absent-value boundaries at tests.rs:110–524, the existing rule/decision/assert_route helpers already remove routine construction noise, and replacing typed conditions with JSON, a builder DSL, a generic scenario engine, or an arbitrary sibling file would rearrange or hide this complexity instead of deleting it.
